title: Lodge a general consumer complaint
summary: NSW Fair Trading can help consumers or traders lodge a general complaint about goods or services if they have been unable to resolve the dispute privately.
intro:
If you're a consumer or trader involved in a dispute relating to goods or services, and you've been unable to resolve the matter privately, you can seek advice from, or lodge a complaint with, NSW Fair Trading. They'll act as an informal negotiator, at no charge.

You can lodge both general complaints and specific complaints online.
who_can_apply: Any person can lodge a complaint.
NSW Fair Trading cannot intervene in business-to-business complaints concerning goods or services that are to be onsold.
what_you_need: Name and contact details of the retailer, supplier, or dealer you are complaining about.
Details of the goods or services in dispute, including dates, manufacturers/models, costs, and the method of payment.
Details of your complaint, the resolution you have suggested, or any offers made.
What you would like the retailer, supplier, or dealer to do for you.
A copy of receipts, contracts, correspondence, or other relevant supporting information (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Gather the information and documents needed.
Complete the online application form (allow about 30 minutes).
Download and complete the General complaint form – PDF.
Gather your supporting information and documents.
Lodge your complaint at a Service NSW Centre or by post to the address on the form.

more_info.text: You'll need to read and confirm the declaration that the information is accurate and may be provided to the retailer, supplier, dealer, agent or landlord for the purposes of resolving the dispute.
For more information, visit NSW Fair Trading.

faqs.q: Who can lodge a general consumer complaint?
faqs.a: Any person can lodge a complaint, but NSW Fair Trading cannot intervene in business-to-business complaints concerning goods or services that are to be onsold.

faqs.q: What if I run a small business and have a dispute?
faqs.a: If you run a small business, you should visit the Small Business Commissioner website for help with resolving a dispute.

faqs.q: How can I lodge a general complaint?
faqs.a: You can lodge complaints online, or lodge them at a Service NSW Centre or by post.
